fault_definitions.NO_RETURN: Record three pre-decision entries, exit 23 without a raw or envelope.
fault_definitions.MALFORMED_RETURN: Seal 49 journal entries and a valid native body, exclusive malformed return envelope containing a single opening brace.
fault_definitions.UNKNOWN_CLOCK: Four pre-decision entries, no completion count seal; saved copy has no valid policy-decision array; wrapper count is null.
fault_definitions.WRONG_SOURCE: Change one native source digest in the copied body; bind wrapper to those changed bytes.
fault_definitions.WRONG_INPUT: Change native dispatch identity in copy, retaining legitimate request identity and hashing modified bytes.
fault_definitions.ARCHIVE_COLLISION: Pre-existing read-only sentinel score bytes block exclusive score archive after native return validation.
fault_definitions.BAD_CERTIFICATE: Clear the last public decision certificate map of this donor copy; keep original records and scientific input identical.
fault_definitions.MISSING_LEFT: Remove true left face at native t=2 in this donor copy, retain right/before. Never supply a substitute left.
fault_definitions.HELD_ID_LOST: Transport acknowledges no job ID after accepting held submit; no release possible.
fault_definitions.RELEASE_ACK_LOST: Release request recorded; no trustworthy worker or scheduler observation; all first-row slots potentially started.
fault_definitions.TERMINAL_UNOBSERVED: Complete first worker, then no terminal evidence after three observation attempts; keep fully known calls, stop next row.
